name: ICRGroupCharacteristicCS
title: ICR Group Characteristic
description: Characteristic codes for ICR Group profiles — the geographic-scope characteristic that links a target-population estimate to its Location, making estimates computably joinable to the location hierarchy (working doc §7.6), plus the age-band characteristic used to scope age-specific denominator Groups (espen-forms).

concept.definition: The Location (admin unit, settlement, or operational area) this target-population estimate is scoped to.
The age band (e.g. 1-4, 5-14, 15+ years) this target-population estimate is scoped to.

The travel-time band to the nearest (or the catchment's own) health facility this estimate is scoped to — an accessibility stratum of the geography's population (ICRTravelTimeBandVS: walking / driving, under 1 h, 1–4 h, over 4 h). Pairs with the geography characteristic: 'people in this catchment more than 4 hours' walk from the facility' (catchments round, Sep 2026).
